name: Surahi Ewer
short_description: A tall, swan-necked ewer in the court style of the Bahmani sultans. Pure silver wire forms flowing vine scrolls and floral medallions across the matte black alloy.
care: Dust with a soft microfibre cloth and keep away from water.
image_alt: Surahi Ewer — Bidriware with silver floral vine inlay

name: Bulbous Vase, 12"
size: 30.5 cm high · 22 cm at the widest
short_description: A full, rounded 12-inch vase inspired by the Bahmani court, with sheet-silver cutwork panels between fine silver-wire tendrils.
care: Display indoors in a dry place. Buff gently with a dry cotton cloth.
image_alt: Bulbous Vase, 12 inch — Bidriware with dense silver floral inlay

name: Lotus Bowl
short_description: A scalloped footed bowl: eight lotus petals unfold from a central rosette, each chiselled by hand and filled with hammered pure silver.
care: Decorative — not for wet food. Clean dry with a soft cloth.
image_alt: Lotus Bowl — Bidriware with silver lotus petal inlay

name: Peacock Platter, 14"
short_description: A 14-inch display platter with a silver peacock framed by concentric floral bands. Hundreds of silver inlays catch the light.
care: Dry clean only. Store wrapped in a cotton cloth.
image_alt: Peacock Platter, 14 inch — Bidriware with silver peacock inlay

name: Tea-light Holders, Pair
short_description: A pair of tea-light holders with fine silver-wire starbursts that catch the flicker of the flame — a classic festive gift.
care: Let wax cool, then lift it out with a wooden spatula. Never use a metal knife.
image_alt: Tea-light Holders, Pair — Bidriware with silver starburst inlay

name: Royal Elephant Statues, Pair
short_description: Hand-cast elephants draped in ceremonial cloths inlaid with pure silver vine arabesques and floral headgear.
care: Dust the carved contours with a soft, dry brush. Do not wash.
image_alt: Royal Elephant Statue — Bidriware with silver ceremonial cloth inlay

name: Elephant Letter Knife
short_description: A letter opener crowned with a sculpted Bidri elephant, its cloth picked out in pure silver — a desk tool and a small sculpture in one.
care: Wipe with a soft, lint-free cloth. Keep dry.
image_alt: Elephant Letter Knife — Bidriware with silver detailing

name: Heirloom Hip Flask
short_description: A pocket flask with a silver jaali medallion on a Bidri body, and a food-grade stainless steel inner chamber.
care: Rinse the inner chamber with warm water. Wipe the outside dry straight away; never soak it.
image_alt: Heirloom Hip Flask — Bidriware with silver jaali medallion

name: Coaster Set of Six
short_description: Six coasters, each inlaid with its own silver pattern, stacked in a matching Bidri holder.
care: Wipe condensation with a soft cotton cloth. Never put under running water.
image_alt: Coaster Set of Six — Bidriware with silver geometric inlay

name: Wine Goblets, Pair
short_description: A pair of stemmed goblets with dense floral silver-wire arabesques around the bowl.
care: Rinse the inside with lukewarm water and pat dry at once with soft linen.
image_alt: Wine Goblets, Pair — Bidriware with silver floral inlay

name: Executive Bar Tray
short_description: A rectangular serving tray framed by a silver-inlaid border, with a dense floral field across the base.
care: Wipe with a damp cotton cloth and dry immediately with a soft towel.
image_alt: Executive Bar Tray — Bidriware with silver floral border inlay

name: Pen Rest & Desk Tray
short_description: A weighted pen rest with jaali motifs from the Mahmud Gawan madrasa, inlaid in pure silver.
care: Dust with a soft, dry cloth.
image_alt: Pen Rest and Desk Tray — Bidriware with silver jaali inlay

name: Visiting Card Case
short_description: A pocket card case with a spring catch, decorated with delicate floral sprays in silver wire.
care: Carry it in its cloth pouch, away from keys.
image_alt: Visiting Card Case — Bidriware with silver floral inlay

name: Domed Paperweight
short_description: A heavy domed paperweight with a sunburst of silver wire radiating from a central rosette.
care: Buff the dome with a dry cotton cloth.
image_alt: Domed Paperweight — Bidriware with silver sunburst inlay

name: Royal Paan-Daan Box
short_description: A traditional ceremonial box with an inner partition and a domed lid covered in pure silver floral vine work.
care: Wipe with a dry microfibre cloth. Don’t store anything damp against the bare metal.
image_alt: Royal Paan-Daan Box — Bidriware with silver floral vine inlay

name: Keepsake Casket
short_description: A velvet-lined keepsake casket with the Bahmani court lotus pattern inlaid in solid silver.
care: Keep somewhere dry. Brush the velvet lining gently.
image_alt: Keepsake Casket — Bidriware with silver lotus inlay

name: Bahmani Court Huqqa Base
short_description: A museum-grade recreation of a Bahmani royal court huqqa base, with dense low-relief silver inlay and fine silver-wire work. One of one.
care: An archival display piece — handle with cotton gloves.
image_alt: Bahmani Court Huqqa Base — Bidriware with dense silver relief inlay
